materials: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: game cartography surface material atlas, a single 3-column by 2-row grid of six equal square tiles, 1536x1024 canvas. Primary request: AAA realistic satellite-view surface materials for a somber gray-dark fantasy terrain map. All six tiles show only continuous surface texture, straight overhead, no horizon or raised large objects, no writing, no borders or gutters. Top left: muted gray-sage dry meadow with natural fine grass and mottled soil. Top middle: weathered gray-brown exposed rock, fractured stone and craggy granular facets under soft northwest light. Top right: dark desaturated slate-blue calm lake water, delicate irregular ripples and subtle soft reflections, no shoreline. Bottom left: aged muted charcoal-brown thatch roof surface, parallel fibers and weathered wood, no whole building. Bottom middle: overhead dark gray-green conifer needle foliage, tiny dense organic branches, no separate whole trees. Bottom right: damp gray-brown gravel and silt, scattered small stones, no footprints or path. Photographic realism, restrained contrast with readable natural detail, cool gray overcast light. No neon, no vivid green or cyan, no symbols, no terrain geography, no houses, no people, no embossed contours, no generated map features. Precise equal tile boundaries.
flames: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent sprite atlas for a game map, two narrow flame markers. Input image 1 is the exact shape and realism reference (thin flame on black). Replace the black backdrop with genuine transparent alpha. Create TWO slender upright flames side by side, left red-orange player flame, right icy electric-blue companion flame. Match the reference's very tall narrow taper, single wavering tongue, sharp pointed lower root, thin split wisps around the middle and two tiny detached embers above. Bright warm ivory core fades through yellow and orange to a RED edge on left; bright white-cyan core fades through cyan to vivid BLUE edge on right. Wispy irregular photographic fire detail and contained subtle glow, no chunky cartoon multi-tongue campfire, no solid black pixels in backdrop, no round halo disk. Canvas 1024x1024 divided into two equal invisible vertical cells. Each flame centered exactly at x=256 or x=768, respectively. Lower root at y=922 (90% canvas height); highest ember at y=85. Each full luminous flame including glow at most 200 pixels wide, with generous transparent space either side. Both root anchors and scale identical. No text, no logo, no frame, no ground, no smoke clouds, no perspective. Preserve reference flame silhouette closely.
